message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad has checked Elena's calendar and the conflict is still there. He will check again at the beginning of his next session. It's the end of the workday on Friday, so it's unlikely anything will change until Monday morning.

I've done all I can for now. I've read the calendars I have access to, identified the only potential time slot, and I'm waiting for Brad to confirm that the slot has become free. I have re-read the calendars for Priya and Marcus, and nothing has changed.

I will write a short message to Brad to acknowledge his message and confirm that I am also on standby. There are no other actions for me to take at this time.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.name: append_workspace
function.arguments: {"text":"Thanks for checking, Brad. I agree that it might take some time for her to see the email and take action. I'll be on standby and will wait for your update in your next session. I'm ready to book the meeting as soon as we get the green light."}
